title: Aloe Vera Gel or Night Cream at Night: Which Should You Use?
ex: Aloe gel is light and cooling but mostly water. A night cream holds moisture in overnight. Which suits your skin, and how to use aloe gel under night cream.
rt: Aloe Vera Gel or Night Cream at Night? Which to Use | Mirc Glow
rd: Aloe vera gel or night cream at night? See which suits oily, dry and sensitive skin, how to use aloe gel under night cream, and seasonal swaps for India.
keyword: aloe vera gel or night cream at night
quick: For most people, night cream is the better overnight choice because it moisturises and helps hold water in. Aloe vera gel is light and cooling but mostly water, so it can leave skin tight by morning. Very oily skin can use aloe gel alone on hot nights, and others can layer gel under a thin cream.

Night cream adds oils that help hold moisture in
Apply aloe gel first, then night cream on top
